system_prompt_style.note: Paper does not describe how the system prompt is built; it mentions a per-task 'mandatory requirement' reminder and per-hand-agent prompts but gives no mechanism.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The hand-level Agent generates demand-matching file operation functions based on the task requirements, which are then invoked within a sandbox envi-ronment.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: The summarization process is essentially a com-pression of the execution steps and results from the current turn.
context_compaction.note: Per-turn summaries plus a typed memory-retrieval mechanism (Analysis/Summary/Task instances) select which history is sent. This is paper-described only; no code was available.

observation_format.evidence_quote: These functions return the specific results obtained after execution.
observation_format.note: The paper plans multimodal output as future work.

tool_call_format.note: The paper shows edit_file(...) function-style commands but does not describe the parser or call format.

tool_count.note: The paper names edit_file, replace_function, Trace_code_switch, open_file and browser commands, but gives no full count.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: replace function(file name, function to replace, new code), which re-places a specific function in a given file based on its signature
edit_primitive.note: edit_file uses start_line/end_line plus line-string checks (line_range_edit). replace_function is signature-based, so it is coded ast_aware as the closest value.

protocol_standardization.note: No protocol is mentioned. No repo was available to grep, so absence cannot be shown.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: it will sequentially perform the following actions: reasoning and analysis, task scheduling, task execution, results evaluation, and summa-rization.
loop_primitives.note: Brain agent assigns tasks and hand agent executes them; the brain agent then evaluates the result and retries on failure.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The output of this step includes specific task objec-tive, detailed steps, and expected outcome.
planning_granularity.note: Brain-level tasks are delegated to hand-level agents.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: agents are divided into brain-level and hand-level agents. The brain-level agents handle all the reasoning, while the hand-level agents are responsible for executing tasks

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: If the Agent determines that a task needs to be exe-cuted, the brain-level Agent will assigns it to the hand-level Agent.
delegation_mechanism.note: The paper does not say whether a new conversation is spawned.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote:
It is a fully
autonomous, multi-agent workflow
human_in_loop.note: Paper states each step is autonomously determined by the agent; no human gating described.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: All responses (string) generated by the model will be parsed in a specific way and uniformly stored in historical memory as instances in sequence.

long_term_memory.note: The memory mechanism is within-run only; persistence across runs is not described.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Automated linting prompts were enabled after code edits
self_verification.note: The brain agent evaluates results against the expected output (same model, self_critique).

retry_policy.note: Scope may be task-level rather than whole-run.

rollback.evidence_quote: allows for modifi-cation of these patches at any time using git commands

termination_condition.evidence_quote: the infinite loop continues until the result satisfies the requirement or the budget is run out.
termination_condition.note: The experiments set max iterations to 100 and cap cost at $10.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: For simple and repetitive tasks, smaller and cheaper, or open-source models are utilized for ex-ecution, serving as the hands of the Agent.
cost_controls.note: A $10 max cost is set in the experiments.

timeouts.evidence_quote: the maximum timeout in the sandbox was set to120s

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: which are then invoked within a sandbox envi-ronment
execution_isolation.note: The paper says 'sandbox' but does not specify the type.

network_policy.note: Web browsing is used, so network is likely open, but this is not stated.

eval_hooks.note: Benchmark results are reported, but no evidence of a shipped runner.

guardrails.evidence_quote: If they do not match, the Agent will automatically issue prompt commands to guide the LLM in adjusting the original edit file() command
guardrails.note: The line-string mismatch check blocks wrong edits.

target_domain.evidence_quote: hand-level agents are responsible for executing tasks by invoking dif-ferent tools, such as file editing, web browsing, and code execution
target_domain.note: Also evaluated on AIME, GPQA and Codeforces reasoning tasks.

open_source.note: The Table 1 open-source column shows '-' for Infant Agent.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: The litellm package was used to standardize the output format for both Claude-3.5-Sonnet and GPT-4o.

primary_artifact.note: No repo was provided in the evidence.

first_release_date.note: Basis: paper v1 date (no tag or repo available).
